approaches.title: Prefix maximum and suffix minimum scan
approaches.summary: Precompute the minimum value from each index to the end, then scan left to right while maintaining the prefix maximum. Return the first index whose maximum-minus-minimum score is at most k.

revisions.commitBody:
- set largest early to gate empty input vectors
- build postfix with reverse iteration to enable bounds-check
elimination
  - we minus from the index instead of plus to allow LLVM to prove the
bounds
- final loop zips the two slices so indices are provably in bounds

dunno if compiler actually performs bce lul
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Kept the same prefix/suffix strategy while handling empty input, building suffix minima in place over a clone, and zipping the arrays during the final scan.
